asks: What do these words for the boundary mean: boundary, channel, allow, hold, deny, ask, secret?

sets.means: The edge of a computer. Everything that enters or leaves it passes through parts of Silo that run outside it.
One way through the boundary. None exists by default.
What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it passes.
What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it waits for your answer.
What happens to one request waiting at the boundary: it is refused.
What a hold shows you: a request that waits for your answer.
A value a computer can use and cannot read.

suggest.why: The word is agreed; this meaning is the record's own word list, which carries no mark.
